messages.content: You translate English into Italian. The user sends a JSON list of strings. Translate each string faithfully and plainly. Keep numbers, dates, document names, article and annex references, product and company names, and any text between quotation marks exactly as they are. Do not add or remove information. An empty string stays empty. Return only a JSON list of strings of the same length, in the same order, with no other text.

["The facts do not mention model CS-400, so they cannot say whether it may stay under internal production control after 20 January 2027; the general rules are in the corrigendum points on the Directive's repeal (fact 56) and the placing-on-the-market date (fact 50)."]

response.text: ["I fatti non menzionano il modello CS-400, quindi non possono dire se possa restare sotto controllo interno della produzione dopo il 20 gennaio 2027; le regole generali si trovano nei punti del corrigendum sull'abrogazione della direttiva (fatto 56) e sulla data di immissione sul mercato (fatto 50)."]
